page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, page number at top right. No margin notes. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot, on the last line's baseline.

main_text.l: horum enim pectoribus, omnes Amoris, Re-
verentiæ, Fidei scintillas ita penitùs sopitas
aut extinctas cupiunt, ut nunquam possint re-
accendi in illum ardorem, quo vel Mea vel
Legum, vel Regnorum meorum Libertates
(quas omnes pariter eversas cupiunt) vigeant
amplius aut restituantur; existimatione mea
ereptâ via pulchre sternitur ad eripiendum
mihi vitam & Regnum: Regno enim indi-
gnus jam nec vitâ dignus judicabor. Accura-
ta igitur sævitiâ pariter & astutiâ cogunt prius
exequias Honoris Mei celebrare, ut mox inte-
ritu meo parentetur. Sed haud dubio veram
illam Dei Justitiam, nec errori nec affectibus
obnoxiam posse aliquando & velle perversa
hominum studia, & consilia evertere; Potest
ille efficere, & (ut spero) efficiet, ut in bo-
num meum cedant quæ in me pessima Inimi-
ci vel cogitarint, vel fecerint.
Nil me interim aliud existimo hâc Litera-
rum interceptione, quàm tot Chartulas tan-
tum perdidisse. Quantum vero Illis perierit
Humanitatis famæ (quæ cùm omnibus debe-
tur, certè omnium maximè ab iis qui singula-
re præ se ferunt pietatis studium) quantum
etiam Reverentiæ & Honoris Regi suo debiti,
& præsens ætas & futura optimè judicabit.
Sed nec Ipsas Eorum conscientias arbitror
ita penitùs in stuporem datas, ut non sensu ali-
quo secreto afficiantur pudoris illius & Infa-
miæ quæ inhonesta facinora comitatur, ut-
cunque publicâ adulatione, & populari Gratiâ
commendata.

page.notes: Page number "195" is read from a worn numeral; uncertain, marked [?]. Running head is Greek (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ.) as printed in the header; the Greek letters are hard to make out at this scan resolution, so the whole head is marked [?]. "Certe" and "K" stand on the same line as the last printed line "commendata," at the right: read as catchword and signature. Italic "Litera-rum" is hyphenated across the line end as printed. Hyphens kept on re-accendi, debe-tur, Accura-ta, ut-cunque, which are line-end breaks. Long s normalised to s; u/v and i/j normalised. Printed ligature "ct" in "pectoribus" is set as ct.
